description: The kinds of act a call can perform, each with its yes-or-no test. A dispatch record's act_kind holds one of these names, or unrecorded (<reason>) when no test was applied or none passed. A kind is never given by guess.

kinds.name: verdict-or-review
kinds.test: Does the call return a ruling on whether work may go ahead, or a review of instructions an agent loads, measured against a standard that existed before the work?

kinds.name: deliberation
kinds.test: Does the call settle or challenge how work still to be done should be shaped, without ruling on whether it may go ahead?

kinds.name: build
kinds.test: Does the call change what a program, or the instructions an agent loads, does, following a design already settled?

kinds.name: inquiry
kinds.test: Does the call return an account or a catalogue entry with its sources, without ruling on anything?

kinds.name: archiving
kinds.test: Does the call put a stored record out of use, bring it back or delete it, while it stays where it's stored?

kinds.name: transfer
kinds.test: Does the call move something from one place or system to another, so that it arrives unchanged?

kinds.name: conversion
kinds.test: Does the call change the conditions a program runs in, or the form of its input, without changing what the program does?

kinds.name: user-decision
kinds.test: Does the call need someone with authority over the work to set its objective, accept a risk no standing rule covers, or approve or refuse its result?
